Select substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name, canonical_smiles
From metabolism
Join compound_records on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id
Join molecule_dictionary as substrate on compound_records.molregno = substrate.molregno
Left Join compound_structures on substrate.molregno = compound_structures.molregno
Join molecule_dictionary as parent on metabolism.met_id = parent.molregno
Join target_dictionary on metabolism.enzyme_tid = target_dictionary.tid
Filter target_dictionary.pref_name = 'CYP2B6'
Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name
Limit 200
